complete_manuscripts.title: Complete regular application, corrected written scope

scope_note: Complete corrected recovery of the fixed twelve-page article: 46 source clauses, 56 first-atlas examples with arbitrary cores, Table 1 names and vertex figures, and 79 named second-atlas groups across 88 occurrences. Corrected totals are 9,210 regular and 16,974 oriented chiral classes. The larger printed domain omits Sp4(4), without any polytope census or zero claim for that group. Retained classifications, software premises, historical conventions and runtime-trace limits remain explicit. Measurement deferred; no new question, Lean, principal-refutation or compression credit.
